title: Phone sign-in tells a lapsed member their gym may not use the app
what: The phone sign-in only finds a member whose plan runs today. A member whose plan just ended is told 'Your gym may not use MettleUp yet, or it may have another number for you', which is wrong for them and gives no hint to renew. The older 'Find my gym' screen does say it only looks for a plan running today; the new main way in drops that line.
expected: When no running plan is found, say the search looks only for a plan that runs today under the number and first name the gym has, and point a lapsed member to their gym's desk.
how_often: every time a member with an ended plan uses phone sign-in
fix_line: Reuse the Find my gym 'why' line on the phone sign-in not-found screen

title: Privacy line says the number is not kept, but the app keeps it
what: The phone sign-in screen says 'Your number is checked once and is not kept for this.' When a member is found, the app saves the number into their profile and hands the proof to the gym after the join, so the gym's member row is linked by it.
expected: The privacy line matches what happens: the number is saved on the phone and used to link the member to their gym's list.
fix_line: Reword the privacy line to say the number is kept in the app and used to link you to your gym

title: People already using the app never see the new phone sign-in
what: The phone sign-in and its straight-into-the-gym join live only on the welcome's first screen, which shows only to a new install or after demo removal. A member who set up the app before this release is never offered it; their only path is the older 'Find my gym' flow, which does not go straight in or unlock staff features for a found owner, trainer or desk person.
expected: Existing users get the same 'find me by my number' path from inside the app (for example the Gym tab or Profile), including the staff unlock.
who: members and gym staff who installed before the phone sign-in release
fix_line: Offer the phone number search from inside the app for people already set up

title: A second tap while joining shows a false failure
what: If the join is already running (a second tap on Join), the app says 'That did not work. Try again.' even though the first join is still going and may succeed.
expected: A second tap is ignored or shows 'Joining...'.
fix_line: Ignore the second tap quietly instead of showing an error

title: Owner cannot see whether any automatic reminder went out
what: Automatic reminders (plan ending, plan ended, birthday wish, welcome, miss you) are set by each member's phone. Nothing is sent back to the gym: no record of which reminder was set or shown, to whom, or why a member got none. The owner turns a reminder on and believes it ran, with no way to check.
expected: The owner can open a list per reminder: who got it, when, and who did not and why (no app, notifications off, switched off, no date of birth).
fix_line: Have the phone report each reminder it set or showed, and show a reach list on the reminders page

title: Reminders page says members with the app get them, but many silently do not
what: The panel says members with the MettleUp app get these on their phone. In the code a member gets nothing unless: the app is linked to this gym, the member's 'Reminders from my gym' switch is on, Android notifications are allowed, and the phone is Android (iPhone sets none). Birthday also needs a date of birth on the member page. The owner sees only how many reminders are on, never how many members each will reach.
expected: Next to each reminder: 'reaches N of M members', with a per-member reason for those left out.
how_often: every day; real reach on Crispy Curves not counted (no database query in this step)
fix_line: Show the reach count and reasons on the reminders page and say iPhone is not covered

title: iPhone members get no gym reminders, pop-ups or pushes
what: The gym reminders, the 15-minute notice pop-ups and the push address all stop when the phone is not Android. The panel's reminder words say members with the app get them, with no iPhone exception.
expected: Either iPhone gets them, or the panel and the iPhone app say plainly that iPhone members do not get reminders or pop-ups yet.
how_often: every iPhone member, once the iPhone app is in members' hands (live status not checked here)
fix_line: Say 'Android only for now' on the panel, or build the iPhone notifications

title: AI suggests writing birthday wishes the app already sends
what: Today's AI suggestions list 'Birthdays today: N, Write birthday wishes' and lead to a WhatsApp send. The automatic 'Birthday wish' reminder (on by default) already wishes those members on their phone. The suggestion never reads whether the automatic wish is on, so members with the app get two wishes and the owner redoes work the system already did.
expected: The suggestion says who already gets the automatic wish and offers WhatsApp only for the rest.
who: owners and members with a birthday
how_often: every day with a birthday, when the birthday reminder is on
fix_line: Have the birthday suggestion read the automatic reminder switch and leave out members it covers

title: Manual plan-ending WhatsApp send does not know the app already reminded
what: The owner's WhatsApp 'send to next' list remembers only who was sent in this browser. It does not know the automatic 'plan ends soon' and 'plan ended' reminders, so app members get the same news twice, and nothing tells the owner which members are already covered.
expected: The send list marks members the automatic reminder already reached, or skips them.
who: owners and members near their plan end
how_often: every plan-ending message sent by hand
fix_line: Mark app members who already get the automatic reminder in the send list

title: Hiding your name on the leaderboard can fail without telling you
what: When a member turns off showing their name on the gym leaderboard, the phone tells the gym. If that fails (no signal, server error) it is one quiet log line; the app retries later, but the member is never told their name is still showing at the gym.
expected: The switch shows 'Not hidden yet, will retry' until the gym has heard.
how_often: cannot be proven in the cloud, needs a real-phone check (only when offline or the server fails)
fix_line: Show a pending state on the name switch until the gym confirms

title: A frozen member still gets 'We haven't seen you' reminders
what: The desk's 'Freeze / extra days' only pushes the plan's last day later and writes a note line. The phone's 'we haven't seen you' reminder looks only at the last check-in and whether a plan runs, so a member on a medical freeze is told the gym misses them N days after their last visit, and the AI Away lists cannot tell a freeze from a dropout either.
expected: A freeze is a status every reminder and away list reads; no 'miss you' while frozen.
who: members on a freeze, and their owners
how_often: every frozen member whose freeze is longer than the 'miss you' gap (default 14 days)
fix_line: Store a freeze as dates the reminders can read and skip 'miss you' inside them

title: Database change notes disagree about what is live
what: The bell to-do database change still opens with 'NOT APPLIED LIVE, waits for the owner's yes', while the panel's What's new says it went live on 16 Nov and the panel was deployed on 17 Nov. Other changes (gym pack read, billing feature checks, direct-read record) also say not applied. Anyone reading the files cannot tell what the live database runs.
expected: Each database change file says its true live state, and a live-state list is kept from the real database catalog.
how_often: every audit or fix that trusts the file header
fix_line: Check the live migration list once and correct each file's first line
